items.title: The first deliverable from generative coding should be understanding
items.description: Federal modernization will gain more from generative coding systems when they first make legacy estates legible—mapping dependencies, preserving rationale, and exposing risk before proposing change.

items.title: The CMMC suspension is an organizational knowledge test
items.description: The CMMC Phase II suspension lowers the immediate pressure of third-party certification, but it does not remove the obligation to protect defense data—or the need to preserve the organizational knowledge built around that work.

items.title: From signals to strategic options
items.description: How agentic AI can help turn scattered external change into evidence-backed innovation options without replacing strategic judgment.
